name: Araithia Shokta
description: A character in Caligo who held the Spirit-Gem.

timeline.summary: Teyo Verada's first planeswalk lands him in the middle of the Promenade, where Araithia Shokta helps him out of the cart traffic.
timeline.quote: Teyo Verada had his first planeswalk

citation.text: "Transguild Promenade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat guides Teyo, newly arrived on Ravnica, sharing what she overheard about planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Rat acted as Teyo Verada 's guide to the city plane when the young planeswalker first arrived.

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat, Teyo and Kaya meet the Orzhov triumvirate, and Bilagru convinces them to join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selesnya agrees to help after Trostani awakens and overrules Emmara Tandris.
timeline.quote: her decision was overruled when Trostani awakened and ruled in favor of helping the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat convinces Borborygmos to support the cause.
timeline.quote: Rat convinced the cyclops (who had a soft spot for her) to support their cause.

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska returns and unites the Golgari, pledging them to the fight, and civilians are evacuated to the tunnels.
timeline.quote: Vraska pledged the Golgari to the fight against Bolas.

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Rix Maadi, Tomik brings Hekara's corpse, the cultists resurrect her as a blood witch, and she defeats Exava and leads the Rakdos against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heartbroken that Teyo and Kaya will leave, Rat departs without goodbye, but Teyo finds her and she joins them.
timeline.quote: Rat was heart-broken and left their company before saying goodbye

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Dominaria, Rat helps find Liliana, defeat an imposter, and persuade Kaya to let Liliana live.
timeline.quote: Rat helped convince Kaya to let Liliana live

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazav recruits Rat into the Dimir and brainwashes her into a secret assassin.
timeline.quote: Lazav periodically approached Rat in various forms as he slowly brainwashed the young girl

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Atkos Tarr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazav sculpts the persona Atkos Tarr for Rat, who assassinates Dovin Baan.
timeline.quote: Lazav had Atkos Tarr assassinate Dovin Baan in his secret safe house on Ravnica .

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Atkos Tarr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya befriends Teyo and fights Bolas's forces with Araithia and Ral.
timeline.quote: Alongside many other planeswalkers and Ravnicans, Kaya fought against Bolas' forces

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Trostani awakens and the Selesnya agree to help the Gatewatch; Araithia wins over the Gruul.
timeline.quote: Trostani awakened and ruled in favor of helping the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin speaks through the Gem to Araithia and appears to Liliana, telling her she must choose her path to redemption.
timeline.quote: Ugin briefly spoke through the Gem to Araithia Shokta and appeared to Liliana Vess

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teyo wanders Ravnica, guided by Rat, and is joined by Kaya and Ral Zarek, who explain he is a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: who explained to him that he was a planeswalker

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teyo and Rat rally the Orzhov Syndicate after Bilagru convinces the triumvirate.
timeline.quote: the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya takes Teyo and Rat to Gobakhan; Teyo finds his powers far outshine the monks and leaves again.
timeline.quote: Teyo discovered that his powers now far outshone those of his fellow monks and acolytes

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Dominaria Teyo frees Liliana from her trance and deduces that the fake Liliana draws power from a bound djinn.
timeline.quote: Teyo attempted to remove the gold collar from Liliana's neck, which jolted her back to her senses

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat destroys the amulet freeing Zahid, who tries to kill Teyo; Liliana subdues Zahid with the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Liliana then used the Chain Veil to subdue Zahid and save Teyo.

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teyo travels with Kaya and Rat to Fiora to join Liliana, now called Ana Iora, on her path to redemption.
timeline.quote: Liliana, who had changed her name to Ana Iora

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin speaks to Araithia and Liliana through the Spirit-Gem, and Liliana gives up the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Liliana dropped the Veil and gave it up.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zarek and Beleren task Kaya with bringing the Golgari, Rakdos, Gruul and Selesnya to the table for Operation Desperation, and Rat offers to help.
timeline.quote: But Master Zarek and Mister Beleren tasked Mistress Kaya with bringing the other four wayward guilds

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat leads Kaya, Teyo and Nissa through secret routes past the Eternals on the way to Selesnya.
timeline.quote: I know most of the secret routes through Ravnica

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat slips inside and meets her godfather Boruvo, who is moved to help.
timeline.quote: my godfather, Keeper of my Life Pledge, the Selesnyan spearmaster Boruvo

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Boruvo carries Rat to her friends and through the Ledev line, and demands that Nissa be sent away; Nissa leaves to join Gideon.
timeline.quote: I've never been very good at talking. You two go with the centaur. I'll join Gideon.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Rat is invisible to Nissa and nearly everyone, and Rat explains that she is insignificant by birth magic.
timeline.quote: I'm not invisible. I'm insignificant . A rat.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat leads Kaya and Teyo through the sewers, picking a lock, to Skarrg, where Gan Shokta and Borborygmos are fighting.
timeline.quote: Gan Shokta was fighting with the cyclops Borborygmos

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat fetches her mother Ari Shokta and tells her Hekara is dead.
timeline.quote: But Ari . . . Hekara's dead.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gan Shokta and Ari show Gan that Rat is present and Rat urges them and Borborygmos to unite the Clans.
timeline.quote: You must unite the Clans and help the other guilds.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat whispers to Borborygmos and kisses his cheek, winning the Gruul over.
timeline.quote: I cupped my hands and whispered again. Then I kissed his cheek.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya ghosts through Ral and aims his face at Rat so he can see her; Rat explains she tracked him for Hekara.
timeline.quote: From behind, Mistress Kaya literally grabbed his face in both of her once-again-solidified hands and aimed it at, well . . . me.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The group enters Korozda unopposed and Storrev welcomes them to Svogthos, with Rat whispering her name to Ral.
timeline.quote: The Golgari Swarm welcomes you to Svogthos.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat urges Kaya to give Vraska the benefit of the doubt, and Kaya and Zarek accept Vraska's offer to help.
timeline.quote: Then Mistress Kaya sighed heavily and turned to Queen Vraska to accept her help.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: With the Golgari tunnels to Rix Maadi closed, the group surfaces and sees that the portal is gone from Tenth District Plaza, so the Planar Bridge has been shut down.
timeline.quote: Now, it was clear that Mister Fayden, Mister Karn, Miss Samut, and the Demon-Man Ob Nixilis had successfully shut down the Planar Bridge, as well.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Vraska senses that the Immortal Sun has been shut down; the group chooses to stay and finish the work.
timeline.quote: It's down. The Immortal Sun has been shut down.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat dreads entering Rix Maadi without Hekara.
timeline.quote: I dreaded going down there, into Rix Maadi.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The party descends the Demon's Vestibule past Rakdos performers, whose puppeteer shows a Hekara marionette that throws razors at Zarek and Vraska.
timeline.quote: Seemingly of its own volition, the Hekara puppet threw very real razors at Zarek and Vraska.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the Festival Grounds and enters Rix Maadi, which is strangely empty.
timeline.quote: Queen Vraska muttered, "Screw it," and marched through the arched gothic doorway.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Tomik Vrona arrives with an Orzhov thrull carrying Hekara's corpse and returns her to her people.
timeline.quote: I have brought Hekara back to her people.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara emerges from the Jester's Crypt alive, resurrected as a blood witch.
timeline.quote: What's your hurry, partners?

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara calms the hellhound Whipsaw and walks past Rat without noticing her, revealing that her resurrection has left her unable to see Rat.
timeline.quote: She walked right past me—without noticing me at all.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Representatives gather at the ruins of the Embassy of the Guildpact; Rat explains Operation Desperation and the Firemind's Vessel placed on Niv-Mizzet's bones.
timeline.quote: Chief Varryvort gently placed the Vessel atop Master Niv-Mizzet's blackened bones.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Ari and Gan Shokta see Rat; Rat tells Boruvo, Ari, Gan and the Selesnya to get along.
timeline.quote: Both squinted at the space next to Teyo until they could see me.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo shields all seventeen from the God-Eternal's fist until the ritual completes, then collapses.
timeline.quote: Teyo reached up with both hands and manifested a half sphere of light that covered all seventeen of us.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Gideon addresses the second summit at the Azorius Senate House and lays out a two-pronged attack to finish Bolas with Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Then I'll stab Bolas with Blackblade. And it will all be over.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
timeline.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat protects Teyo, Kaya and Hekara during the fight.
timeline.quote: So I focused on protecting those three.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara performs with puppets and cannot remember what Rat looks like; Rakdos carries her off.
timeline.quote: I can't quite remember what Rat looks like.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat destroys the sapphire amulet, releasing the djinn Zahid.
timeline.quote: Rat stole the sapphire amulet and destroyed it, which released the djinn named Zahid

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark, Tin Street fills with celebrations and Araithia Shokta cries in an alley.
timeline.quote: Tin Street became the site of numerous celebrations marking the hard-won victory.

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ari raises Rat as Gruul, but her relationship with Boruvo soured after his defection.
timeline.quote: since Rat's godfather Boruvo defected to Selesnya

citation.text: "Ari Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark, Rat returns home and Ari hugs her tightly.
timeline.quote: Ari scolded Rat for shouting but then hugged her tightly

citation.text: "Ari Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat tells Ari that Gan Shokta and Borborygmos are fighting; Ari helps mediate and attends the ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet.
timeline.quote: She was present during the ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet

citation.text: "Ari Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gan Shokta and the Gruul arrive in time to save Kaya, Teyo and Araithia from the Eternals; Gan is nearly killed and saved by the trio.
timeline.quote: Gan Shokta was almost killed by an Eternal but was saved by the combined efforts of Teyo, Kaya, and Araithia.

citation.text: "Gan Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gan confronts Borborygmos over the guild's direction until Rat and Ari bring urgent news; Gan accepts the outsiders on seeing his daughter.
timeline.quote: Gan Shokta engaged in a conflict with him over the direction of the guild.

citation.text: "Gan Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Araithia Shokta intervenes and convinces Borborygmos to let go of his grudges, allowing the Gruul to band together with the plane's defenders.
timeline.quote: Gan's daughter Araithia Shokta intervened and convinced Borborygmos to let go of his grudges against the other guilds

citation.text: "Skarrg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ral, Kaya, Teyo and Araithia are brought into Svogthos by Storrev seeking aid against the Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: were allowed through Korozda and brought into Svogthos by the lich Storrev

citation.text: "Svogthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: He is her godfather and Keeper of her Life Pledge.
relations.quote: my godfather, Keeper of my Life Pledge

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

relations.quote: She was such a loyal friend, right?
